messages:
maria: Heads up - SOC requested we extend 'evidence' retention to 3 years for incident artifacts exported to partner SIEM. Need quick thoughts on RBAC, KMS gating, and any compliance landmines. TL;DR: is 3y ok and how do we safely expose exports to vendor for forensics?
dan: Do we have a precise definition of 'evidence' vs 'operational' logs? we should avoid long-term storage for PII-heavy audit logs unless redacted.
lee: From compliance: forensics evidence (pcap, full request logs) can be 3y if legal requires, but access MUST be JIT + approval + immutable audit trail. Also confirm vendor location (EU residency).
priya: Proposal: separate buckets for evidence vs ops. Evidence bucket uses S3 Object Lock (GOVERNANCE), SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key that only Sec can rotate. Exports to vendor via presigned URL that expires and IP restricts.
samir: Vendor people should never get IAM in our account. Create an 'siem-exporter' proxy service that writes to a partner-bucket or hands off via signed, logged transfer. Keep minimal perms.
maria: Current flow: SIEM_EXPORT job -> internal bucket (30d) -> archive -> long-term if flagged. Need an exception path. Current job config pasted: 
```yaml
jobs:
  siem_export:
    schedule: daily
    output_bucket: s3://redwood-siem-export
    lifecycle_days: 30
```
dan: Add an approval_required flag and require a ticket id. Use short-lived signed tokens for vendor fetch. Every fetch must log requester, approver, ticket id + chain-of-custody tags.
audit-bot: audit-bot: New requirement recorded: export_access_must_record(ticket_id, approver, requester). See policy SEC-3312.
lee: KMS question: prefer double-wrap for exported artifacts. Suggest envelope encryption: re-encrypt with an export-specific CMK (export-CMK) before handing to vendor, then revoke local key access when transfer completes.
priya: We can use KMS Grants to issue time-limited grants to the exporter role and then revoke. Alternatively do a one-time HSM wrap and store wrapped key id in ticket metadata.
samir: RBAC plan: two roles: siem_read_only (SOC + platform triage) and siem_export_approver (security leads). All vendor transfers go through exporter proxy that only accepts approved tickets and emits audit events.
maria: Action items: priya -> draft export flow w/ KMS grant & object-lock; samir -> least-priv role docs + policy examples; dan -> retention classification matrix for log types (evidence vs ops). Aim RFC by EOW. @lee can you sign off on compliance check?
lee: :+1: I'll review. Also flag: EU-data residency may force partner storage in region, so export path must support region-restricted buckets.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: scheduled: security/forensics sync Thu 10:00 for RFC review (calendar invite sent).
maria: Thanks all. I'll open RFC PR and attach a sample ticket template + example CLI to request export. Sample CLI for requester: 
```bash
redwood-cli export-request --ticket SEC-1234 --bucket evidence-locked --ttl 3600
```
dan: Quick note: redact or pseudonymize user identifiers where possible before long-term retention unless legal needs full fidelity.
priya: Will include pseudonymization options in the draft and the re-encrypt step.
maria: If anyone objects to 3y retention for 'evidence' call it out in the PR, otherwise we'll proceed with draft implementation plan. :eyes:
